name: Pumpkin patch
about: A fenced patch full of pumpkins, with a stack of hay and glowing jack o'lanterns.

layers.name: Path
layers.tip: On flat grass, dig a short path from the front and fill it with gravel.

layers.name: Fence, hay and pumpkins
layers.tip: Put a fence all around with a gate at the front. Stack hay bales in the back corner and put pumpkins all over the grass. Use shears on one to carve a face.

layers.name: Jack o'lanterns
layers.tip: Put a torch with a carved pumpkin to make a jack o'lantern. Put two on the hay, and a torch on each front corner.
